name: farenheit
description: Geographic price transparency for digital products — see how much less (or more) you'd pay for the same subscription from a different country.

interface.shortDescription: Find out what you're overpaying for, by country.
interface.longDescription: Companies charge different prices for the same digital product depending on where you appear to be browsing from. farenheit surfaces those differences — live where possible, reference data where not — and tells you exactly how much you're leaving on the table across streaming, SaaS, software, cloud, gaming, and hardware subscriptions.
